nodes.label: ML-KEM-768 Module-Lattice-Based Key Encapsulation Mechanism
nodes.description: NIST FIPS 203 primary standard for post-quantum public-key encryption and key establishment based on the Module Learning With Errors (M-LWE) hard problem, targeting NIST Security Category 3.

nodes.label: Compute Express Link (CXL) 3.1 Dynamic Capacity Device (DCD)
nodes.description: CXL hardware feature enabling host systems to dynamically assign, reclaim, and pool memory regions without rebooting, managed via CXL Fabric Manager events.

nodes.label: MADAMIRA Morphological Analysis and Disambiguation System for Arabic
nodes.description: System combining SVM and language modeling techniques for morphological analysis, POS tagging, diacritization, and lemmatization of Modern Standard and Egyptian Arabic.

nodes.label: W3C SPARQL 1.1 Entailment Regimes Recommendation
nodes.description: W3C specification defining semantic query evaluation semantics under RDF, RDFS, OWL, and RIF entailment models over RDF knowledge graphs.

nodes.label: GraphBLAS Masked Matrix Multiplication Triangle Counting Algorithm
nodes.description: Parallel graph algorithm for counting triangles in undirected graphs using masked matrix multiplication C = (A * A) .* A over element-wise semirings in GraphBLAS.
